errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has an interval of 5 years, but the major tick marks are every 10 years (20, 30, 40, 50).
The description refers to 'Die blaue Linie' (the blue line), but the chart contains two blue lines (one dark blue, one light blue). It should have been more specific.

errors.text_span: steigt zunächst stark an, erreicht ein Minimum von etwa 32 % im Alter von 22 Jahren
errors.evidence: The phrasing is contradictory and confusing. It claims the line 'first rises strongly' and then immediately 'reaches a minimum'. This poorly describes the initial trend which rises from age 20 to 21 and then dips at age 22.
